ns2:section.sectionText: Meeting the world's growing energy needs in a sustainable fashion is one of the most pressing problems today. This course will introduce the scope of the energy problems, define some of the options for sustainable energy, and look into the basic physics and chemistry of emerging sustainable energy technologies including batteries, fuel cells, solar cells, solar fuels, etc. State-of-the-art nanomanufacturing methods and advanced characterization of functional materials for sustainable energy applications will be discussed. This course is pre-approved by the MechSE UPO to count as a MechSE Elective course for ME students.
